extraction_notes:
SOURCE: Crooke ST et al. (2017) 'The Effects of 2'-O-Methoxyethyl Containing Antisense Oligonucleotides on Platelets in Human Clinical Trials', Nucleic Acid Ther 27:121-129. PMID 28145801 / PMCID PMC5467133 / doi:10.1089/nat.2016.0650. This is the pooled Ionis integrated safety database (ISDB): 59 trials, 16 distinct 2'-MOE phosphorothioate ASOs, 3,476 subjects (2,618 ASO-treated).

WHAT WAS FETCHED AND PARSED. (1) Main text: full JATS XML from the PMC efetch endpoint (131,902 chars). All seven main tables are real XML <table> elements and were rendered with a colspan/rowspan-aware parser, so every Table 3-7 cell is a literal transcription, not an OCR guess. Body text and the Fig 1 caption were extracted from the same XML. (2) Supplementary: the Europe PMC supplementaryFiles zip, containing a 10-page 'Supp_Data.pdf' and fig-1.jpg. The PDF is fully text-extractable and was read with PyMuPDF; all of Supplementary Tables S1-S12 were recovered as text. Fig 1 and Supplementary Figs S1/S2 are raster images.

LICENCE / REDISTRIBUTION. The article's own PMC licence field is CC-BY-NC 4.0 (ali:license_ref ...ccbynclicense, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/). The NC clause conflicts with a CC-BY dataset release, so EVERY row in this lane carries redistribution='summary_stat'. The 16 sequences in the oligos array come from the same CC-BY-NC table; each oligo's notes field flags that their redistribution is likewise restricted and should be verified before release.

COVERAGE. Table 3 (the dose-response backbone) was extracted exhaustively: 72 rows = panel A (5 nadir bands x 8 dose groups = 40) + panel B relative block (2 x 8 = 16) + panel B absolute block (2 x 8 = 16). Table 4: 30 rows. Table 5: 8 rows (only the '>10% incidence' row, whose denominator is ASOs not subjects; the '<0.7 x BSLN' row of Table 5 duplicates Table 3 panel B and was not re-entered). Table 6: 60 rows. Table 7: 4 rows. Supplementary S4: 10 rows. S6: 80 rows. S7: 32 rows. S8: 14 rows. S9: 9 rows. S11: 18 rows. S12: 24 rows. S2/S5 baseline platelet means: 16 context rows. Body text + Fig 1: 10 rows.

DELIBERATE OMISSIONS. (a) Supplementary Table S7 'Study period' rows are numerically identical to Supplementary Table S6 and were not duplicated; only the Treatment-period and Follow-up-period rows were taken. (b) Supplementary Tables S1 and S3 (trial and subject counts) and S10 (antithrombotic medication usage by ATC class) are study-design/co-medication metadata, not platelet readouts, and were not turned into measurement rows; their content is summarised in oligo notes instead. (c) Supplementary Table S2/S5 gender, race, age and BMI rows are demographics, not platelet readouts.

WHAT COULD NOT BE OBTAINED. Fig 1 (ISIS 104838, 12-week phase 2 rheumatoid arthritis trial, 100/200/400 mg/week) and Supplementary Figs S1 and S2 are raster images with no tabulated values anywhere in the article or supplement. Digitising trend lines off a scatter plot would be estimation, so those rows carry readout_value='TBD' and describe the trend qualitatively in notes (dose-ordered decline, recovery after the last dose, no group trend line approaching the 50 K/uL reference line). Likewise the mipomersen 200 mg/week vs 70 mg three-times-weekly comparison and the time-to-onset statement are qualitative in the source and carry readout_value='TBD'. NO VALUE IN THIS FILE WAS RECALLED FROM MEMORY OR INTERPOLATED.

CONVENTIONS A CONSUMER MUST KNOW.
1. dose_or_conc_value carries the mg/week dose BAND EXACTLY AS PRINTED ('>0-75', '>75-175', '>175-275', '>275-375', '>375-475', '>475') wherever the source reports a band rather than a single dose. It is therefore a STRING, not a float, for most rows. Midpoints were deliberately not invented. Placebo rows use '0'; rows pooling every dose ('ASO total') use 'TBD'. dose_or_conc_unit is 'mg' throughout (the schema enum has no mg/week member) and every row's notes states that the dose is per week.
2. Placebo and active-comparator arms are kept as rows so the negative-control evidence survives. Placebo rows from pooled tables carry oligo_name "2'-MOE ASO class pool" with dose '0'; placebo rows from mipomersen-specific tables carry oligo_name 'mipomersen' with dose '0'. Every such row says 'PLACEBO CONTROL ARM' in its notes. The Table 6 'Total' columns pool placebo + mipomersen and are flagged as impure exposure groups.
3. "2'-MOE ASO class pool" is a PSEUDO-OLIGO for class-level aggregates across all 16 ASOs. Rows carrying it must never be attributed to an individual compound. Only Tables 4, 6, 7 and S11 (mipomersen), Fig 1 (ISIS 104838) and two Discussion sentences (ISIS 416858) are compound-specific.
4. GRADING. A NON-ZERO incidence row is graded by the SEVERITY OF THE EVENT, with the incidence carried in readout_value, however small that incidence is: LLN-100 K/uL and <LLN -> grade 1; <100-75, <75-50 and <75 K/uL -> grade 2; <50-25, <25 and <50 K/uL -> grade 3. Relative bands are graded <0.7 x BSLN -> 1 and <0.5 x BSLN -> 2 (a >50% decline is treated as a monitoring-triggering moderate signal; note that neither relative band fixes an absolute count, and mean baseline was ~245 K/uL). An EXPLICIT ZERO incidence is graded 0 instead, because no subject experienced the event at that exposure - that is the schema's grade 0. Each such row states in its notes which grade the band WOULD have carried had the incidence been non-zero, so the severe-band cells remain findable.
4a. CONSEQUENCE WORTH KNOWING BEFORE YOU MERGE: this lane contains NO grade-3 rows. That is not a gap in the extraction - it is the finding. Every severe-band cell in the source (<50-25 K/uL, <25 K/uL, <50 K/uL) is an explicit zero in every table and every dose group, including >475 mg/week. In 2,368 ASO-treated subjects and ~800 person-years there was not one confirmed platelet count below 50 K/uL. 82 rows sit on those severe bands, all at incidence 0 and therefore grade 0. The severe idiosyncratic thrombocytopenia that prompted the paper (the IONIS-TTRRx and volanesorsen phase 3 events) is described in the Introduction and Discussion as motivation but is NOT quantified anywhere in this article, so no grade-3 row could be created from this source without fabricating one. Grade-3 evidence for inotersen and volanesorsen must come from the regulatory-label and trial-report lanes, not from here.
5. GRADE DEVIATION, declared: the schema rubric lists 'bleeding/hemorrhagic event' under grade 3, but this source states all bleeding events were mild and the mipomersen incidence (1.1%) was LOWER than placebo (1.6%). Those rows are graded 1 (or 0 where the incidence is zero) rather than 3, on the basis that the grade-3 criterion targets clinically significant hemorrhage. Every affected row says so in its notes.
6. is_platelet_specific is FALSE for the coagulation rows (S12 APTT/PT, factor XI activity), the injection-site administration-reaction rows and 'hematocrit decreased' - all adjacent-hematology or local-reaction fallbacks. Everything else is TRUE.
7. Baseline platelet means from S2/S5 are context rows (grade 0, effect_direction no_change, readout_unit 10^9/L). They let a consumer convert the relative endpoints (<0.7 x BSLN, <0.5 x BSLN) to approximate absolute counts.
8. ps_count in the oligos array is recorded as length-1 on the strength of the Table 1 footnote ('2'MOE ASOs were phosphorothioate modified and all cytosine residues were methylated at the five position'). The individual linkage count is NOT enumerated in the source; each oligo's notes says so.

IDENTITY / JOIN KEYS. oligo_name is 'mipomersen' (ISIS 301012, stated explicitly in the article body), 'volanesorsen' (ISIS 304801) and 'inotersen' (ISIS 420915); the latter two are within-source inferences - the article names 'volanesorsen' and 'IONIS-TTRRx' and Table 1 contains exactly one APOCIII ASO and exactly one TTR ASO, but the ISIS-number-to-INN link is not printed. Both inferences are flagged in the oligo notes. All other compounds use the ISIS development code exactly as printed in Table 1 (e.g. 'ISIS 104838', 'ISIS 416858'). 'ISIS 416858 = IONIS-FXIRx' IS stated in the article body. max_phase is the phase reached within this source only; ISIS 113715 and ISIS 404173 are both 'TBD' because Table 2 shows a PTP1B ASO reached phase 2 but the source never says which of the two it was.

measurements.notes: Grade rationale: clinically relevant bleeding occurred but at a LOWER rate than the active anticoagulant comparator, in a surgically anticoagulated population -> mild -> grade 1 | HIGH-BLEEDING-RISK STRESS TEST. oligos.notes: PSEUDO-OLIGO / CLASS-LEVEL AGGREGATE, not a single compound. Used for every pooled row of the Ionis integrated safety database (ISDB): 59 trials, 16 distinct 2'-MOE phosphorothioate ASOs, 3,476 subjects (2,618 ASO-treated per Table 1; Supplementary Table S1 gives 32 phase 1 / 21 phase 2 / 6 phase 3 trials). Rows carrying this oligo_name must NOT be attributed to any individual compound. Placebo-arm rows from pooled tables also carry this name with dose 0 and are flagged in the row notes.
